component.name: Daymural
component.summary: Daymural: daily Microsoft Bing wallpaper applet for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: Bring Microsoft Bing's daily UHD image to the COSMIC desktop, browse a local wallpaper history, and optionally match the system accent color to the current image.
Daymural is an unofficial, independent project and is not affiliated with, authorized by, sponsored by, or endorsed by Microsoft.
